notes:
Lead profile: small NYC-based edtech building a teacher-facing classroom copilot and content moderation for student submissions.

Key pain: teachers need quick suggestions (summaries, quiz questions) and auto-moderation of student uploads to avoid flagged content in classrooms. Budget-sensitive — founder explicitly: "We need something that doesn't blow our token budget; aim <$0.01/token avg across workloads." Interested in hosted API for fast time-to-value, public cloud only for now.

Technical bits / asks:
- Prefers smaller quantized models for inference cost savings; wants fallback rules if latency spikes.
- Needs simple SSO (SAML) for teacher accounts; audit log access for compliance with district partners.
- Data retention: ideally 30 days, with option to purge PII on request.
- Throughput: peaks during class start/end. Target burst concurrency ~150 req/sec for short windows.

POC plan: 3-week sandbox: integrate hosted API into teacher UI, test moderation thresholds on historical corpus, compare cost with local LLM baseline. If cost OK -> 3-month paid pilot across 3 schools.
